historical_record.description: Classical Revival flats that replaced an 1882 cottage. Ionic columns frame the entrance; there are pilasters at the corners of the bay windows, a course of dentils and profiled cornices.

building.completed_conflict: The assessor dates the building to 1900; the city's historic context statement for this area gives 1902-1903.
